name: Czechia: Part II package and CTIS upload check
applies_to: the Czechia package as a whole (plan-level checklist step)

items.check: Machine-readable list of documents with versions and dates present (cover letter or separate file).

Czech PIS/ICF for the main population, and one L1 set per population in population_sets whose trigger is true; every special pathway has its document (parents and 12-14 and 15-17 information, legal representative and adapted information, emergency, witness, pregnancy, future use).
Other participant materials (diaries, cards, questionnaires, instructions for use, e-questionnaire screenshots) present in Czech.
items.applies_when: participant_materials.used or endpoint_documents.participant_facing or imp.self_administered or devices.used_in_trial

items.check: K1 recruitment and informed-consent procedure present with every Czech national field of Template No. 1 and a section for every population pathway.
K2: every recruitment advertisement, leaflet and other material, non-print formats in their own format where possible.
For every Czech site: M1 CV on SÚKL Template No. 2 and M2 declaration of interest on Template No. 3, both in Czech and signed; N1 on Template No. 4 signed.
Machine-readable Czech list of trial sites and principal investigators present.
Regional Authority evidence for non-state or non-Ministry sites and sub-sites.
SÚKL GCP certificate scans for bioequivalence, pharmacokinetic or First-in-Human sites.
Insurance certificate, complete policy with terms and conditions (Czech or bilingual) and the sponsor statement on post-trial damage compensation present.
Sponsor-signed SÚKL Template No. 5 in the Part II data-protection category.
SÚKL Template No. 7 completed in full.
Compensation and reimbursement information on Template No. 6 (or with references to every Template No. 6 item) and the funding description present.
Part II fee: not paid at initial submission; payment evidence planned for the validation stage according to the designated Ethics Committee.
Medical-device documents per the current KLH-CTIS-01 scenario.
Every participant- or representative-facing document is Czech; no English original and no standard bilingual PIS/ICF.
CV, declaration of interest and site list are Czech; insurance documentation Czech or bilingual; other administrative documents in the language set in requirements.json.

No signatures in uploaded K and L documents; M1, M2 DoI and N1 signed at submission and R1 signed by the sponsor, each with a SÚKL-accepted signature method (not DocuSign or a non-compliant sponsor-created signature).
Certified translations for foreign nationals are planned as non-substantial amendments based on the approved Czech version.
Compensation amounts, payment method and conditions identical in P1 and every participant document.
Insurer, cover and participant obligations identical in O1, O2 and every participant document.
Sample types, storage, coding, future use and retention identical in S1, the protocol and the participant documents.
Sponsor, controller, data flows and recipients identical in R1, the participant documents and the protocol.
Consent pathways in K1 match the L1 sets in the package.
Sites and principal investigators identical in CTIS, the site list, M1, M2 DoI and N1.
Versions and dates in the document list match every uploaded document.
Documents adapted from the reference package contain all Czech national additions and no leftovers from the reference country.
items.applies_when: Czechia is not the reference package

items.check: Correct B-S section prefix and CTIS placeholder for each document; the PIS/ICF under the SÚKL category stated in the guide.
Unique, self-explanatory title of at most 100 characters: <section code>_<document type>_<subtype>_<country>_<language>_<special attribute>, with only the fields that distinguish the document.
Version and date entered in CTIS metadata, not in the title.
Personal names only where disclosure permits (principal investigator in M1/M2).
Clean, tracked-change, redacted or public and split-file variants clearly distinguished.
Uploaded filename base contains none of ( ) / , . ; | [ ] (the period before the extension is fine).
Titles marked as proposals in requirements.json (document list, site list, N facility documents, O3, P2, fee proof, device documents) confirmed (DECISIONS.md).
Article 11 workaround: every mandatory Part II placeholder holds the official placeholder PDF titled Part_II_placeholder_document_Article_11_workaround.
items.applies_when: Czechia receives Part I only under Article 11

items.check: For each document, publication status checked against the current Annex I publication tables (revised CTIS transparency rules; ACT EU guidance v2.2, 30 April 2026).
Publishable documents: personal data and CCI identified separately; the public version redacts only qualifying material.
Public and assessment versions differ only by the intended redactions; each in the correct CTIS slot.
No personal data or CCI in public structured fields.
No drafting instruction remains in any document (see content/conventions/template-instructions.md).
Every document approved by the owner in TrialAgents, or the user has explicitly chosen to export unapproved versions.
